ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the diagram there is a plant, with a brown root system at the bottom, and in the center there is a vertical green structure extending upward from the roots, connecting the leaves and the red flower at the top. The letter B is located in the middle left side of the diagram, and its indicator line points near the vertical green supporting structure at the center of the plant. Reasoning: In the plant structure, the vertical green part that connects the roots, leaves, and flower, and serves as the central support, is the stem. Therefore, label B refers to the stem.
